bot./about: How Morrow Brief works Morrow Brief is built from Morrow, a daily paper that reads hundreds of headlines and merges coverage of the same story across outlets. • Selection is automated: the most widely reported stories come first. • Nothing is rewritten. Headlines belong to their outlets and every story links to them. • A number after an outlet, like +3, counts the other outlets that carried the same story. • Replies follow the latest edition, so /today changes when the paper does. Not financial advice. Full edition · Source code
bot./privacy: Privacy This bot has no database. It keeps no list of users and stores no messages: it reads the command you send, answers from today's public edition and keeps nothing afterwards. No sign-up and no ads. Story links go straight to the outlet; the bot adds nothing to them. Telegram carries the message, so Telegram's own privacy policy covers the app itself. The code is public: github.com/juw12/morrow
